review.tagline: Example notebooks and guides for building with the OpenAI API
review.summary: Collection of runnable Jupyter notebooks and guides showing common tasks with the OpenAI API. Most examples are in Python, and the README says the concepts apply to other languages. Running them requires an OpenAI account and an API key set as OPENAI_API_KEY. The guides are also browsable at cookbook.openai.com.
review.audience: Developers learning to build with the OpenAI API
strengths: Maintained by OpenAI, so examples track the official API
Runnable notebooks; API key is read from OPENAI_API_KEY or a .env file
Also browsable as a site at cookbook.openai.com
weaknesses: Requires an OpenAI account and API key; examples do not target local models
README does not list topics, versions or per-notebook dependencies
